purpose: Determine whether FACETS 4.5.0 can execute its own bundled inline-data example after the user-reported Windows restart, independently of every project-generated specification and dataset.

execution.launch_path: the same invoke_facets helper and CREATE_NO_WINDOW behavior as registered calibration
execution.specification_change: none; the bundled file is copied byte-for-byte

decision_rule.pass: return code 0 and a nonempty report
decision_rule.fail: classify the observed failure as FACETS executable/runtime scope rather than project-input scope; do not execute supplemental calibration or read preflight endpoints

claim_boundary: External-engine availability diagnostic only; it neither replaces a calibration pair nor reads a scientific endpoint.
